summary: Ported the complete seven-commit sgl-model-gateway proposal from calvin0327/sglang commit 0832be69911baba0ee8648e61a8a6e0119023567 onto the prepared base: unified GatewayConfig and CLI conversion, simplified main, decomposed startup, owned background-service shutdown, and structured logging. Added CLI compatibility/adversarial coverage and fixed a reproduced shutdown regression where the health checker waited for its polling interval until the server's 10-second fallback timeout.

tests.what_was_measured: All 344 gateway library tests passed, including direct-vs-launch CLI equivalence, legacy defaults, invalid PD bootstrap ports, OpenAI transport compatibility, and immediate health-checker shutdown. Raw output: reports/j-777d9358b1de/raw/cargo-test-lib.log

The focused OpenTelemetry integration test passed against a mock HTTP worker and collector, exercising request/response structured logging and trace propagation. Raw output: reports/j-777d9358b1de/raw/cargo-test-otel-focused.log

Nine tests passed; the unrelated redis fixture test failed because redis-server could not be executed (Permission denied). The target tracing tests passed. Raw output: reports/j-777d9358b1de/raw/cargo-test-otel.log

A fresh optimized native gateway binary was built with the repository-pinned rustc 1.90.0 at /tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-777d9358b1de/cargo-target/release/sgl-model-gateway. Build identity is retained in reports/j-777d9358b1de/raw/version.log

Failing-before regression: after SIGINT the proposed code waited 10 seconds and logged 'Worker health checker did not stop before timeout' (13 seconds total). Raw output: reports/j-777d9358b1de/raw/graceful-shutdown-before.log

Passing-after regression: the rebuilt server accepted SIGINT and completed shutdown immediately at the 3-second trigger, without the health-checker timeout warning. timeout returns 124 when it initiates the signal. Raw output: reports/j-777d9358b1de/raw/graceful-shutdown-after.log
Rust formatting and patch whitespace validation passed. rustfmt emitted only the repository's existing stable-channel warnings for nightly-only formatting options.

remaining_limitations: No Kubernetes service-discovery cluster, multi-node mesh, TLS deployment, or production model worker was available; those paths compile and are covered by existing unit tests but were not exercised end-to-end here.
The full otel_tracing_test binary had one unrelated environment failure because redis-server was present but not executable; the focused tracing test passed independently.

No GPU/model validation was performed because it is not applicable to this control-plane refactor; the startup smoke validates the rebuilt gateway lifecycle only, not model semantics or distributed workloads.
